Threat actors may use AI technology and tools to develop new, more sophisticated attacks or automate or increase the frequency of such attacks

We use software and platforms designed to detect such cybersecurity threats, but these threats could become more sophisticated and harder to detect and counteract, which may pose significant risks to our data security and systems
ai_positioning.summary: VICI adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, reconnaissant les risques cybersécurité accrus liés à l'adoption d'outils IA par elle-même et des tiers, tout en mettant en place des mesures de détection sans certitude d'efficacité.
